thread:
Maya: Heads up — running into a confusing error in the Python SDK during onboarding. Token expired, request returns a 401 but the SDK surfaces a generic 'InternalServerError: Request failed' to the app. Breaks the sample-app flow. Anyone seen this?
Sam: Seen similar. I think the runtime returns 401, but our py client wraps and rethrows as a generic 5xx class in some codepaths.
Jordan: That explains parity gaps. Node returns a typed AuthError for 401, py sometimes bleeds the transport message into the top-level exception.
Li: From UX side this is rough — sample-app shows "something went wrong" with no retry hint. New users get stuck.
Sam: Proposal: SDKs should expose consistent typed exceptions (AuthError, RateLimitError, ClientError, ServerError, NetworkError) + a small metadata map: {"status": int, "retryable": bool, "retry_after": str?, "hint": str?}.
Maya: Agree. Also we should parse Retry-After and include it on RateLimitError. Right now nobody surfaces that to callers.
Jordan: Example mapping I prototyped:
```
# client mapping pseudo
if status == 401:
    raise AuthError(message, status=status)
elif status == 429:
    raise RateLimitError(message, status=status, retry_after=resp.headers.get("Retry-After"))
elif 400 <= status < 500:
    raise ClientError(message, status=status)
elif status >= 500:
    raise ServerError(message, status=status, retryable=True)
```
Li: Can we include a short, user-friendly hint string for onboarding flows? e.g. "Check your API key expiry or re-run `ri login`" for AuthError.
Sam: Yep. Hint should be optional and localized in docs rather than hard-coded, but a concise default is useful.
Maya: Two follow-ups: 1) sync with eng-runtime on consistent status codes being returned (weird 500 wrapping we saw), 2) update python SDK error surface to the typed model.
Sam: I'll own the py SDK change. Plan: add typed exceptions, include metadata dict on exception, and update sample-app to show specific message + CTA. ETA: early next week.
Jordan: I'll do a quick checklist for parity tests across SDKs (node, py, go). Add unit tests asserting exception classes + metadata fields.
Li: I'll update sample-app UX text and docs snippets; will also add a short onboarding note: if you see AuthError -> show re-auth CTA.
Maya: Nice. One more thing — telemetry: add an error-class field to logs so we can alert if >N auth errors during onboarding. error-bot can surface a weekly spike.
error-bot: (automated) created ticket INF-4321 to track: "SDK: unify error types & attach retry hints".
Sam: pushing a draft PR now to the py repo: link in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Great — once PR is up I'll add parity tests and run the sample-app smoke.
Maya: Thanks all. Let's avoid leaking raw transport messages to users (stack traces are fine in debug mode, but not in production UI).
Li: Agreed. Small copy note: prefer active instructions in hints (e.g. "Run `ri login` to refresh credentials") rather than vague suggestions.
Sam: PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/py-sdk/pull/124 (draft). Please review.
Maya: Reviewing now. If no blockers, we can roll a canary to staging and test onboarding flow.
Jordan: I'll verify parity after staging deploy and post results here.
Maya: Awesome — thanks everyone!
